description: Distant hillside with houses, parked cars on left street side, asphalt street, mature green trees lining right street side, parked cars on right street side, concrete sidewalk, red railing, small light-colored house with porch, tall wooden utility pole with transformer and numerous wires.

Blue sky with multiple parallel power lines, distant cityscape on the horizon, light-colored building partially visible behind a wooden fence, metal street sign pole with attached signs, dark brown wooden fence with vertical slats, white multi-level house with dark trim around windows and horizontally across the lower section, a flat roof with a metal chimney and an antenna/pole, and a gabled roof section with a window, concrete sidewalk, asphalt street, light-colored neighboring house with an arched entry visible on the right.

Tall evergreen tree, white stop sign with "BUENA" street name, white circular no-trucks-over-3-tons sign, yellow diamond sign, asphalt road with white crosswalk/rumble strip markings, brown and green sloped terrain, light-colored houses including one with a reddish-orange tile roof and exterior stairs, green bushes and trees covering hillsides, white sign post, clear blue sky.
